1955 — 1960 TUBE COMBO

Tweed
Deluxe.

Two Volumes and one Tone, and they all interact.

This is the 5E3, the narrow-panel Deluxe Fender built from 1955 to 1960. Two 6V6s, a 5Y3 rectifier, cathode bias, and no negative feedback loop on the drawing. Most owners will tell you there isn’t much clean headroom. It’s breaking up by the time it’s loud enough for a band, and plenty of people buy one for exactly that. The controls are the other thing players talk about. There are two Volumes and one Tone, and they all affect each other, including the Volume for the channel you’re not plugged into. It’s usually listed at 12 watts, and you’ll see 15 quoted too.
